爱莎贝儿-163CM-L 粉肤 RAHC045 望月恵美Mochizuki Emi-解开我拥抱我
她紫眸含媚，轻咬唇角，白纱轻垂肩头。
紫缎薄衣紧裹丰盈曲线，丝带随指尖轻颤，
仿佛在低语：来吧，慢慢解开我，让温柔的秘密在你掌心悄然绽放。

Elsa Babe-163CM-L Pink RAHC045 Mochizuki Emi-Untie Me, Embrace Me
Her purple eyes held a captivating allure, she lightly bit her lip, a white veil draped gently over her shoulders.
A thin purple satin dress clung tightly to her voluptuous curves, ribbons trembling slightly with her fingertips,
as if whispering: Come, slowly untie me, let the gentle secret bloom quietly in your palm.
